research_class: prospective real-source branch-value prediction and single-action choice; research-only no native promotion
question: Can a direct non-gradient tokenless native associative weight bank infer which 16-step action macro improves actual reward in unfamiliar real Memory Gym worlds, using only prior public action/observation experience, and beat fully trained recurrent/MLP and conventional retrieval controls under equal source training/action choice opportunities?
hypothesis: FKP14 privileged multi-branch source headroom is high (+0.23125 best-of-nine vs random) but sparse terminal goals; learned action-value ranking may or may not generalize from source-blind training contexts; dense recurrent or nonparametric controls may tie or dominate numeric programmed weights.

baseline.pr1105: FKP14 source-only genuine action branch headroom PASS: 95738 real source actions, 32 independent worlds, 128/128 identical public prefixes, 103/128 16-step contexts positive branch, +0.23125 privileged oracle-vs-random; exactly one 16-step goal context; source-not-learned
baseline.pr1104: FKP13 actual on-policy direct weights retained but no return superiority or goals, 175302 genuine steps, frozen DEV NO_GO; do not reuse its consumed worlds.

source.allowed_observations: Only environment-returned RGB observation, emitted real reward and done/truncation and own prior legal actions; NEVER env.info, debug renderer, hidden path/goal/coords, env.unwrapped or source-private task state.

cohorts.disjoint: all FKP10–FKP14 consumed source cohorts and FKP14 transfer reserved 974500..974563

protocol.native_macro_actions: all nine legal 3x3 action pairs, action repeated for 16 actual env.step calls after exactly same publicly observed source prefix
protocol.public_prefix: fixed deterministic source-blind 8-step macro choices Random(seed XOR 0xF15A0), total 64 max; anchor 0 uses immediate reset RGB; same public prefix replayed to every branch, verify complete public RGB/actions/rewards/done trace hash
protocol.public_input: historical public sequence of 204 float features: 192 visible 8x8 block RGB mean plus 9 one-hot *last executed* native action and 3 one-hot source-issued last reward sign. At reset, no executed action encoded, prior label neutral. Fixed 204-float summary: arithmetic mean of last at most eight public history features. No hidden world seed as model feature.
protocol.source_ownership: TRAIN and VALIDATION afford all nine real physically replayed future branches per anchor with true 16-step cumulative signed public return. Exclude early terminated prefixes explicitly. On DEV all nine may be queried solely by blinded evaluator *after* each model has frozen a single macro-action selection from the same public prefix; no model may update from DEV alternate outcomes, and privileged max return is an unattainable evaluator ceiling, NOT learned baseline.
protocol.development_disclosure: DEV source environments/seeds are not instantiated until prereg and all source/strong-control code are frozen and both Windows/Linux full exact-candidate regression PASS. Source trained/selected only TRAIN/VALIDATION first; once original DEV opened, do not adjust features, policies, budget or gates; Windows replays consumed source evaluation only.

learners.candidate: Native direct numerical non-gradient 2-view visual-context hash 4096 buckets × 9 macro actions; each learned cell has int32 count and int32 accumulated 1000×native-return, fixed 294,912 raw bytes total. Each real TRAIN branch writes exactly one observed source-issued 16-step return to both hash keys. Predict action value as two-hash sum-return/count Dirichlet-shrunk toward TRAIN per-action return; no gradient or tokenization. Frozen at DEV; exact cold/tamper restore. Hash seed 1515 and 2626, 12 random ± projections of 204 public summary features; no full episode seeds or outcome leakage into hash.
controls: One-hash normalized count-and-sum action-value table with same 4096 slots, identical public TRAIN source return labels and smoothing; no gradient. Strong conventional count baseline.

Fully trained GRU hidden64 one layer over original full PUBLIC 204-feature prefix sequence, head 9 macro return values, seeds1515 and2626, 24 complete Adam epochs per init and best VALIDATION mean squared 9-return loss; no DEV selection.
Fully trained two-layer MLP hidden64x64 over identical public 204-feature eight-step summary, seeds1515 and2626, 24 complete Adam epochs each selected only VAL MSE.
Ridge linear nine action-value regression on same 204-feature summary with regularizers .01,1,100 selected by VAL 9-return MSE; baseline must be genuinely trained.

Nearest-neighbor public summary context regression (k=1,5,15; Euclidean standardized by fixed TRAIN-only scaling) selecting k on VAL 9-return MSE; exact memory of all TRAIN contexts, strong retrieval.

Global per-action TRAIN return mean (uniform action-selection if ties), source-blind deterministic RANDOM action for each anchor and retrospective privileged source best-of-nine ORACLE diagnostic only.
Outcome label shuffled TRAIN negative direct weights with frozen seed1515, no source-private data.
learners.fit: All candidate and conventional models receive exactly the SAME TRAIN world-anchor 9 native continuation outcomes, same legal action choices, and same VALIDATION histories, with entire full TRAIN data prior to sealing and none from held DEV. GRU receives complete public time sequence and can exploit more temporal information; candidate and other vector controls receive summary; report this representation difference, not equal feature dimension at recurrent history level.
learners.control_selection: Prespec training 24 epochs each seed, Adam lr.001 weight_decay.0001, deterministic CPU, batch16 sequences for GRU, batch64 summary contexts for MLP, validation MSE checkpoint; all actual training completed even if apparent early optimum. Always compare strongest DEV controller, reselect strongest control in each world-bootstrap sample.

budgets.max_original_actions: (64+16+32)*4*(1+9)*(64+16)=358400 conservative; count actual paid env.step, fail closed if exceeded
budgets.model_compute: No paid APIs, no GPU; fully train GRU and MLP as above; report full original source acquisition+fit+DEV wall and CPU, parameter counts and numerical bank raw capacity, not claim model compute matched.

metrics.primary: Real environment-issued 16-step source return of each model's SINGLE chosen macro action per valid held DEV anchor; average across 32 independent DEV worlds (4 correlated anchors). Compare learned candidate vs strongest fitted conventional/retrieval controller, same source branch alternatives and chosen-action evaluation budget, not a random unconstrained oracle.
metrics.secondary: Paired absolute reward regret vs unattainable best-of-nine (evaluator only), positive-return branch-choice rate, positive progress event count, rare true terminal goal count, whole source actual actions + resets, cold restore bit exact and tamper rejection, model fit wall/CPU, held context diversity.
metrics.uncertainty: 10,000 bootstrap resamples over DEV worlds (not anchors), seed 1515; for each resample reselect strongest learned/conventional/rand comparator before computing candidate gain; record 2.5/97.5 percentiles.
metrics.scientific_development_gate: DEV_ACTION_VALUE_SIGNAL only if candidate mean per-anchor REAL held source return >= strongest fully trained conventional/retrieval/random action model +0.05, bootstrap lower bound strictly >0, >=0.10 mean regret reduction vs strongest, equal or higher positive action-selection rate, at least 24 valid DEV worlds with all four anchors, >0.05 oracle headroom, exact cold restore/tamper and complete cross-platform fixture/full regression. Goal event is secondary (FKP14 showed only one/128 anchor) and MUST be reported, but is not gate; no scientific_pass until new family/owner protected first-use and whole-process matched compute/transfer qualification.

classification_rules.supported: Only positive public DEV signal if all frozen gates and full exact Linux/Windows engineering; no independent science or native admission
classification_rules.mixed: DEV_MIXED if numerical memory helps some held actions but ties or loses best recurrent/ridge/kNN or misses absolute threshold; preserve outcomes
classification_rules.negative: DEV_NO_GO when score no gain, source delayed-return not predictable even though branchability exists or negative controls tie; no post-result tuning
classification_rules.invalid: Any DEV source before two-OS full preflight, source hidden state, uneven branch histories, incomplete fully fitted control, model selection on DEV, changed prereg/source/horizon/threshold after first-use, earlier consumed cohort used as virgin, protected transfer used

note: High-first delayed-return action choice; explicitly separates action branch headroom from learned action selection. Every actual supervised target comes from ORIGINAL public env.step future actions during TRAIN only; prediction is sealed before DEV branches. Not an autonomous intelligence claim.
